transfer_taxes.name: NYS real estate transfer tax (base)
transfer_taxes.source_title: NYS Dept of Taxation: Real estate transfer tax
transfer_taxes.notes: $2 per $500 of consideration. Grantor (seller) pays; grantee pays only if seller fails/exempt or contract shifts it.

transfer_taxes.name: NYS additional base tax (NYC, residential >= $3M)
transfer_taxes.source_title: NYS TSB-M-19(1)R; NYS real estate transfer tax page
transfer_taxes.notes: $1.25 per $500 on ENTIRE consideration when residential conveyance in NYC is $3M or more (so state base becomes 0.65%). Seller pays.

transfer_taxes.name: NYS 'mansion tax' (additional tax, residential >= $1M)
transfer_taxes.source_title: NYS Dept of Taxation: Real estate transfer tax
transfer_taxes.notes: 1% of the entire price for residential consideration of $1M or more. Buyer (grantee) pays. Applies statewide incl. co-ops.

transfer_taxes.name: NYS supplemental tax (NYC residential >= $2M; stacks on mansion tax)
transfer_taxes.source_title: NYS TSB-M-19(1)R: Amendments to the Real Estate Transfer Tax
transfer_taxes.notes: Computed on entire consideration for wholly residential property. Buyer pays (seller if buyer fails/exempt). Combined with the 1% mansion tax gives 1.25% at $2-3M up to 3.9% at $25M+.

transfer_taxes.name: NYC Real Property Transfer Tax (RPTT), residential Type 1/2
transfer_taxes.source_title: NYC Dept of Finance: Real Property Transfer Tax (RPTT)
transfer_taxes.notes: 1-3 family houses, condo units, co-op units: 1% if value is $500,000 or less; 1.425% if above $500,000 (rate on whole price). Applies to transfers over $25,000. DOF page does not name payer ('usually paid as part of closing costs'; both sign return); customarily the seller (grantor) - payer not confirmed on fetched page.

transfer_taxes.name: NYC mortgage recording tax (city + state), borrower share
transfer_taxes.source_title: NYC DOF 2022 Mortgage Recording Tax Annual Report; NY Tax Law s.253
transfer_taxes.notes: Tier chosen by mortgage amount, rate applied to whole loan. DOF report: residential (1-3 family, condo) combined 2.05% (<$500k) / 2.175% (>=$500k), which includes the 0.25% state 'special additional tax'. Under Tax Law s.253(1-a)(a) (https://www.nysenate.gov/legislation/laws/TAX/253) the special additional tax on small residential property is paid by the mortgagee and may not be passed to the mortgagor; borrower share therefore 1.8% / 1.925%. Co-op purchases are financed with share loans and do not pay MRT.
